# Scene vocabulary

Names that appear in both formats and both APIs. **Joint vs DoF** (mechanism scalars in `q` / `dq` vs XML joint objects): [Rotations and frames — Terminology](rotations-and-frames.qmd#joint-vs-dof).

| Idea | Typical name | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| Rigid piece with inertia | body / link | Mass, pose |
| Allowed motion | joint | Hinge, slide, ball, free… — **one joint can have 1–6 DoFs** |
| Scalar in `q` / `qvel` | DoF | Independent coordinate; **`nv`** (MuJoCo) or **`num_dof`** (Motrix) counts these, not geoms |
| Collision / visual shape | geom | Sphere, capsule, mesh; **not** a DoF — see [Geometry and collision](geometry-and-collision.qmd#geometry-and-collision) |
| Named frame, no mass | site | End-effector, sensor origin |
| Map `ctrl` → force/position | actuator | Motor, position, velocity |

URDF says *[link](http://wiki.ros.org/urdf/XML/link)*; MJCF and [MuJoCo](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/overview.html) say *body*. Motrix exposes both `Body` (rigid body) and `Link` (kinematic frame). Joints, geoms, sites, and actuators are the same ideas in both. Format links: [References — Robotics assets](references.qmd#robotics-assets).
